purpose: Fresh-session comparison only; prior failed development gates preserved; no fitting, calibration or promotion

trials.activity: Scroll feed for 30 seconds, then watch Reels for 30 seconds.
Open a video not used in earlier recordings and watch for 60 seconds.
On a later local date, open a different video and watch for 60 seconds.
On that later date, scroll feed for 30 seconds, then watch different Reels for 30 seconds.

eligibility: mapped-valid-prefix-v1; all supported mapped flows retained; ambiguous/unmapped inventory preserved; no prediction-based exclusion
primary: 10 packets: within each independently referenced class average recall equally over visits with that class, then average the two class recalls; report both models and paired difference
diagnostic_pass: All four usable visits, each class observed on both local dates; prefix primary score >= forest primary score and each prefix class recall >=0.80. Descriptive screen only; no significance/noninferiority/general-accuracy claim or model promotion.
collection: Normal Chrome and Edge app visible; Wi-Fi; reference checkbox on; longer-window statistics off; Strip private information NetLog, sensitive/raw bytes off; cap 120 seconds. User starts both logs before fresh target navigation.
attempts: One stopped session per slot, bind raw snapshot before QC. Unusable attempt stops study; no replacement or extra capture. Archive in order; day1 same local date, day2 same later local date.
scoring: Only after four archived usable visits. No model-score feedback during collection. Paired raw rankings on identical eligible actual prefixes. Uncalibrated prefix always withholds; report withholding separately, never interpret raw probabilities as confidence.
limits: Initial prospective local comparison of selected candidates after reused development. Two visits per service cannot establish broad reliability. No protected calibration/final data used.

followup_scope.reason: Prior third slot lacked reference opt-in and retained zero native flows; no candidate scores were read. Original study remains stopped.
followup_scope.rules: One YouTube and one Instagram on the same later local date. Same models, quality/support, primary metric and embargo. First two inherited visits stay byte-identical, excluded from fitting. Stop on any unusable new session; no extra replacements.
